tei:div.tei:p: oṃ swā sti/ bla ma dang yi dam la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba'i bla ma dang ni de'i chos la/ /dad pas btud nas skabs 'dir brjod bgyi ba/ /blo gros dman zhing brtson pa dang bral yang*/ /bla ma'i bka' drin thob gang gsal bar brjod/ /phyi ma'i dus 'dir shing rta cher grags shing*/ /yon tan dris rgyas grags pa'i rta dmar can/ /phyogs bcur 'god la lhod pa dang bral ba/ /pad dkar zhes bya'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ /sor sdud skabs 'dir rlung sems zin pa'i rtags/ /bshad pa'i sa chu me dang rlung gi rlung*/ /zin pa'i gnad gang zin nyid ci la dang*/ /dbu mar tshud dang de la khyad par ci/ /'dir brjaud pa/ spyir na phyi rol yul la rgyug byed rlung*/ /zlog tu nye dang cung zad zlog pa dang*/ /dbu mar zhugs dang gnas dang thim pa de/ /gnas skabs lnga kar la yang thim rim gyi/ /rtags kun che chung rim pas 'char ro zhes/ /sman zhabs la sogs rgya bod mkhas grub kyis/ /rgyud sde dgongs pa bzhin bshad 'dir bzung bya/ /thim sogs kun la'ang rim pa du ma mthong*/ /re zhig thim dang gtan nas thim pa dang*/ /re zhig thim la'ang rnam grangs mtha' yas yod/ /mnyam bzhag thun gcig bar la'ang skabs lnga dang*/ /ldang ba yod phyir shin tu gnas skabs mang*/ /sor bsam gnyis kyi skabs su rlung rnams ni/ /cung zad ldog pa yin zhes kho bo 'dod/ /de la zin zhes tha snyad sbyar la rag/gnad ni dhū tī'i yas snar rlung sems 'jug /dbu mar cung zad chud pa 'di yang lags/ /ro rkyang rgyu ba 'gags na chud pa zer/ /tha snyad glo bur sbyar ba mang po la/ /brtsad par mi 'os don la dpyod na mdzes/ /tshig gtsor mdzad na skabs 'dir nam mkha'i rlung*/ /dngos shugs gang la'ang ma bstan chad pa'i skyon/ /tshud ces bya ba grong khyer pa yi brda/ /sa yi dngos gzhir smra ba'i skyon du gsungs/ /zhes brjod do/ /dris pa/ rtsa rnams dag tshe dbu ma las gzhan pa'i/

/rnam gzhag rgyud las ma mthong kun mkhyen che/ /'khor ba gnas gyur myang 'das mi bzhed pas/ /ro rkyang 'khor ba'i rtsa sogs gang du song*/ /brjod pa/ nyid kyi lugs la dag pa ci la zer/ kho bo cag ni rtsa gzhan nus pa dag /dbu ma bzhin du ye shes skyed byed la/ /dag ces zer zhing slob dpon so so yi/ /grub mtha' 'gal ba mtha' dag su yis skyong*/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras chen po'i dgongs pa 'chad/ /'on kyang jo nang kun mkhyen 'khor 'das kyi/ /gnas gyur gtan nas mi bzhed rgyu mtshan ci/ /rnal 'byor spyod gzhung grub mtha'i snying por mdzad/ /'khor ba rnam shes brgyad po gnas gyur las/ /myang 'das ye shes bzhi sogs thams cad bzhed/ /'khor ba 'khrul snang med par rtogs pa'i tshe/ khams gsum snang ba thams cad 'gags pa la/ /ro rkyang gnyis la dgaus su dpyod 'di blun/ /grong khyer tshig nas thal bar song shes nas/ /sgo gleg gang la song zhes dpyod dang 'dra/ /'dri na 'khor ba gang du song zhes 'dri/ /mtha' yi rtsa rnams shin tu phra ba dang*/ /dbus kyi rtsa ni shin tu sbom zhes sogs/ /gsungs phyir dbu mar dag pa shin tu bzhed/ /dris pa/ sor sdud nyid kyis grol ba'i gang zag de/ /rtsa mdud gang gis bshig dang dkar dmar gyi/ /'pho ba dag dang bcu gnyis bden don sa/ /rgyu rkyen ci las byung 'di gsal bar smros/ /brjod pa/ lam gzhan rtogs pa rgyud la ma skyes pa'i/ /sor sdud kho nas grol ba yod ma yin/ /sor sdud kho nas grol ba'i gang zag gis/ /tha snyad tshad ldan las med 'dis ci bya/ /rab kyis dang pos rtogs zhes bya ba la/ /rab ces bya bas rim gnyis 'bad pa yis/ /skye ba snga mar bsgoms pa'i gang zag bstan/ de ni tshe 'dir bla mas bsten pa ltar/ /sor sdud bsgoms pa'i rkyen gyis rlung 'gags nas/ khams kyi thim rim mthar phyin rjes dran dang*/ /ting 'dzin sogs kyi rtogs pa skyes la zer/

/skye ba snga mar 'dzin pa'i rjes dran gyi/ /rtogs pa yod na de la 'byung ba lags/ /sor sdud tsam gyi lta ba bzang po dag /shar la grol ba'i ming tsam 'dogs pa mthong*/ /ming tsam la ni bdag cag ga la rtsod/ /bsam gtan phan gyi man ngag bla ma yis/ /ma bstan pas na dang po'i rtogs zhes bshad/ /rtsa mdud 'jig par yan lag phyi ma bzhir/ /dkar dmar thim tshul ting 'dzin skabs su 'byung*/ /dris pa/ srog rtsol dus su phyi nas rngub pa'i rlung*/ /dbu mar zhugs pa'i gnas te 'khor lo gang*/ /de nyid dbu ma'i lam du mi 'jug na/ /rngubs te nang du bkang pa'i dgos pa ci/ /brjod pa/ srog rtsol dus kyi zhugs gnas thim gsum po/ /gtso bor lte ba'i 'khor lor byed pa yin/ /dris tshig 'di las dpags na srog rtsol skabs/ /dbu mar zhugs pa 'ba' zhig khyed bzhed dam/ /dris pa/ rlung rnams phyi rol 'phos pa'i skyon gsungs nas/ /yang 'dir mnyam rgyu'i 'pho ba bsgrub byar bstan/ /gzhan ni de nyid sgra gcan 'chi ltas bshad/ /'di 'dra 'gal med ston pa'i rigs pa ci/ /brjod pa/ re zhig gzhan las zhes 'di ci zhig brtag /dus 'khor yin na gzhan zhes tshig mi 'thad/ /rgyud sde gzhan zhig yin na skabs kyi gtam/ /nyams pa min nam blo ldan rnams kyis dpyod/ /'di la mgo sgre ba'i lan ni/ sa sder shin sbyangs bde ba skye ba'i sngon/ /klad pa lci zhing non pa 'byung zhes ba/ /gzhan du mgo nad yod pa'i rtags su bshad/ /'di 'dra 'gal med ston pa'i rigs pa ci/ /ye shes mgon po mahā kā la ni/ /spyan gsum phyag bzhir sgrub thabs khungs mar 'byung*/ /gzhan du dbang phyug mig gsum lag bzhir bshad/ /de 'dra'i 'gal med rigs pa'ang khyod dris shig /dngos kyi lan ni/ 'chi ba'i rtsa chen bsdud 'bral mar 'bab pa'i/ /mnyam rgyu'i rlung gis dus min 'chi ba ster/ /dbu mar 'bab gang phyi ru rgyu ba na/ /mnyam rgyu kho na lags te 'chi med ster/

/de bzhin 'chi ba'i ltas la'ang dbu ma'i sgo/ /yangs por zhig pa'i mnyam rgyu 'byung mod kyi/ /rnal 'byor stobs kyis dbu mar bcings pa dang*/ / 'dra ba'i the tshom gzhi yang ga la yod/ /dris pa/ srog rtsol gyis ni rlung rnams 'gags byas nas/ /'dzin pas rigs drug rtser mor 'chings de la/ /slar yang ting nge 'dzin der nyi khri dang*/ /chig stong drug brgya 'gag dgos ci ste gsungs/ /brjod pa/ srog 'dzin skabs su rtsol bas 'ching nus mod/ /de ru gtan nas rgyu ba 'gag ma yin/ /ting 'dzin skabs su rlung rnams rtsa ba nas/ /phyin chad rgyu ba med par byas pa yin/ /byams pa bsgoms pas lan dga' zhe sdang bzlog /stong nyid mthong tshe gtan nas bzlog pa bzhin/ khyed kyi ltar na rlung thim rnal 'byor pa/ /rtag tu dbugs kyi 'gyu ba 'chad par 'gyur/ /rlung gi thim tshul srog 'dzin las lhag pa/ /rjes dran skabs nas ci phyir yod ma yin/ /'on kyang thim tshul 'byung ba'i thog ma dang*/ /gtan nas thim pa'i dus gnyis brjod pa yin/ /dris pa/ ting nge 'dzin der rtsa mdud grol ba dang*/ /'dzag bde dag gsungs sngaun ma rnams la min/ /lam 'dir khyad chos lhag po ci zhig yod/ /med na skabs 'dir gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan gang*/ /brjod pa/ ting 'dzin skabs 'dir phyag chen gyis drangs pa'i/ /zhu bdes rang bzhin bde ba mtshon pa yod/ /de yis thig le mi 'dzag mi g.yo bar/ /rang gnas g.yo med bcings pa'i bde ba sgrub/ /'gyur med bde bas rtsa mdud rdzogs par 'jig /'dzag bde'i dbang du de ni 'gyur ma yin/ /dag ces bya ba cung zad mgo gnon dang*/ /sa bon bcom dang gnas ngan len pa spangs/ /gsum la ci rigs dgongs phyir bag yod mdzod/ /las rgyas 'dzag bde sbyin zhes gsungs pa dang*/ /dag bya'i 'dzag bde cig gam tha dad 'dod/ khyod la dri bya kho bo tha dad smra/ dris pa/ lus gcig nyid kyis ye shes sku 'grub pa/

/gsal bar gsungs na rtsa sogs snyigs ma'i khams/ ji ltar dwangs 'gyur sny-igs ma'i phung po 'di/ /spangs na lus gcig de yang ji ltar 'gyur// brjod pa/ gong du ro rkyang gang du song zhes dang*/ /skabs 'dir sny-igs ma ji ltar dwangs zhes pa'i/ /dogs dpyod 'di ni lhag par bzang min te// dogs la gcig gi dogs pa gcig lan btab/ /dkar dmar rlung bcas bcings pas snyigs ma'i khams/ /ngan pa zos nas ye shes skur 'gyur ba// lcags rnams dngul chus gser du bsgyur 'dra zhes/ /gsal bar gsungs pa 'di la dris pas ci/ /spangs zhes bya ba ngo bo spangs pa'am/ shi bas spangs pa nyid la 'dri ba yin/ /snyigs ma yal nas ye shes skur gyur la/ /shi ba'i dogs pa dpyod ldan su la 'byung*/ /ye shes sku dang ma dag lus nyid kyi/ /gzhi mthun med cing ngo bo zhes ma spangs/ /lcags kyi dngos po spangs zhes dper yang gsungs/ /'di la ji skad bkod pa'i skyon yang med/ /thog ma'i rten gyi lus ni cig kho na/ /de phyir lus cig kho nar brjod mod kyi/ /rnam smin ye shes sku de gnyis brgyud kyang*/ /lus gcig nyid la 'ched rgyas zhes gsungs bzhin/ /rgyal ba'i sras por zhal gyis bzhes zin pas/ /rtsod pa lhur len bstan bcos 'os ma yin/ /mkhas pa lan smras 'os yin dri 'os min/ /'khrul dang blun po mkhas par 'chos pa la/ /gdams ngag 'os kyi sdang ba'i yul ma yin/ /dri med rang lugs rgya cher 'jog pa dang*/ /lugs ngan rigs pa'i mtshon cha brgya phrag gis/ /gzh-ig par rigs kyi khyad du bsad pas ci/ /klu sgrub dbyig gnyen chaus kyi grags pa sogs/ /'phags yul mkhas dang phyogs 'di'i shing rta che/ /kun gyi dri ba phyogs bcur 'gyed mi mdzad/ /mkhas rnams gzhan gyi dris na gsong por smra/ /shes bzhin 'dri ba tshar bcad kyi/ /gnas su bshad pa ma yin nam/ /rgyal ba bcom ldan mu stegs la/ /the tshom gcod par ga la mdzad/

/zhus na nye ring med par ni/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi'i char yang 'bebs/ kha ba can 'dir phyi ma'i dus/ /grags 'dod chags sdang dbang gyur rnams/ /rang nyid spobs pa gtugs bzhin du/ /gzhan la dri ba brgya phrag rtsom/ /'di lta bu yi skyes bus ni/ /gzhan la dri ba mi mdzes te/ /gal te gzhan gyis dris gyur na/ /tshig gi dga' ston spel bar 'os// //zhes pa'ang tā ra nā tha yis/ /dri ba'i bstan bcos mthong ma thag /rang gi blo la shar ba rnams/ /thun gcig nyid la yi ger bkod/ /rang lo nyer lnga pa la'o/ /zhus dgadage legs 'phel/ g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing*/ /'phags ma bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /nga tsho phyi ma'i dus/ /de ru skye smon 'debs/ /'di yang ma tis so// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/sbyor drug gi dri lan bzhugs/ -PAGE 396--PAGE 397--PAGE 395-
